subject: general
question: Koneru Humpy is associated with which of the following sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __Chess__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Koneru Humpy**

__
 
• She born on 31 March 1987 in Gudivada, Andhra Pradesh
 
• She is an Indian chess grandmaster and current World Rapid Chess Champion.
 
• The youngest ever to win a World Junior title at 14 years, the youngest woman in the world to earn the GM title at that time, Asian Champion, British Women’s Champion.
 
• She won the individual bronze at the Women's World Team Chess Championship 2015 held in Chengdu, China. 
 
• Koneru won three gold medals at the World Youth Chess Championship: 1997 (under-10 girls' division), 1998 (under-12 girls), and 2000 (under-14 girls).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Awards and achievements of Koneru Humpy :

 
 
• In 2003: Arjuna Award
 
• In 2007: Padma Shri
 
• In 2019: Women's World Rapid Chess Championship
